name: José Cepeda, Paulo Cunha - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should formally join the Council of Europe's Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence. This is the first international treaty on AI. It says AI systems must respect human rights, democracy and the rule of law at every stage of their life. The Parliament's consent is the step needed for the EU to conclude the agreement. The treaty sets a baseline; existing EU laws like the AI Act already go further.

- **What changes:** The EU formally commits to an international AI treaty; EU law already meets its standards.
- **Who it affects:** People using or affected by AI, especially children, creators and voters.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's consent goes to the Council, Commission and member states to complete the EU's conclusion of the treaty.
